# Requirements Checklist: Stop Mixed-Currency Recommendation Totals

**Purpose**: Review whether the summary currency requirements are complete, unambiguous,
and bounded before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on
feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review
artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality
criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for
requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are withheld-total requirements defined for the grand total and for each
  category and action bucket, not only for the page total? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 Are count requirements specified so a withheld total does not drop
  recommendations from the count? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the requirement that the summary call still succeeds, rather than
  failing, written down? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Are out-of-scope boundaries documented for conversion, protocol fields,
  actual-cost currency, per-currency subtotals, allocation, and FOCUS billing versus
  pricing currency? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is a withheld grand total quantified as total 0 and an empty currency,
  rather than left as "do not show a sum"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Is a real zero distinguished from a withheld total by the presence of a
  named currency? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "empty currency" defined as not counting toward distinct currencies
  while its amount is still included? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Is XXX specified as a normal non-empty code rather than as a blank?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do the user-story numbers (100+50, 50+75, same-category mix) match the
  functional requirements and the contract table? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 2, contracts/recommendation-summary.md]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the plan's "no signature change, two copies" stay consistent with
  FR-010, without adding a shared package the spec did not ask for? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, plan.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Can SC-001 through SC-005 be judged from the summary's numbers alone,
  without a new response field? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Is same-currency 100 + 50 = 150 stated as a requirement that must keep
  passing, not only as a success slogan? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements present for a page whose categories use different
  currencies while each category itself uses one? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements present for one mixed category beside one
  single-currency category? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §Clarifications]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are empty input, missing impact, letter case, all-blank currencies, and
  an all-zero single currency addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the spec say what an all-blank total of 0 looks like, so it is not
  silently redefined as a withheld total? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK017 Is the assumption that no caller depends on the old unitless 150 recorded?
  [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the documentation requirement limited to a sentence that states the old
  sum-and-clear behavior, rather than a general docs rewrite? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]

## Notes

- Depth: standard. Audience: PR reviewer. Focus: currency-rule clarity and scope
  boundaries. Non-interactive run; clarifying questions were not asked because the
  parent already fixed the behavior and forbade stopping between stages.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
